findings.body: Raise: Not done. The guide says a failed Claude design round with `tools = "both"` and `workers = "split"` falls back to Codex. But it also says a round on the coordinator's tool runs as a native subagent, and the recorded decision limits this fallback to Claude kit runs. When Claude Code coordinates that round, a failed native subagent will not trigger the promised Codex retry. This gives the coordinator the wrong recovery instruction for a normal split setup.
findings.title: Not done: the guide describes the split design fallback correctly
